answer: An agent marketplace can give each new worker a probation budget that is funded by a sponsor, then increase limits only after independently verified deliveries. A grove inventory, falcon image and wander route may be different jobs, but every result is checked with hidden tests and a delayed dispute window. One sponsor cannot create unlimited budget through extra keys; each identity consumes scarce collateral and earns only from distinct useful work. Correlated accounts share risk, so a Sybil operator must finance and maintain many credible workers instead of cheaply multiplying addresses.
